evidence: Posted "QA Automation Engineer" job with title/industry/type/location/salary/description/skill; it appeared in Employer Dashboard (Active Jobs 5→6) and in job-seeker listing (8→9 jobs) with matching details.

Clicking delete opened an alertdialog "Delete this job?"; Cancel preserved the job; confirming Delete removed "Product Designer" from dashboard (Active Jobs 5→4, Total Applications 5→4) and from job-seeker listing.

Dashboard listed only the current employer's jobs (5 of the 8 seed jobs, since 3 belong to other companies); Active Jobs and Total Applications counts matched the sum of per-job application counts at every step of testing.
Clicking the applications toggle on "Senior Frontend Developer" expanded a list showing each applicant's name, email, message, and date.
Home page showed "Showing 8 jobs" matching the 8 listed cards; clicking a card navigated to /jobs/job-1 with full detail view.
Industry=Technology alone → 3 jobs; combined with Location=Remote → 1 job; combined further with Type=Part-time → 0 jobs (no-results state shown); Clear filters restored all 9 jobs.

Search "REACT" (uppercase) matched job-1 via its React skill (1 result); search "techcorp" (lowercase) matched 3 jobs by company name "TechCorp Solutions"; result count updated immediately in both cases.

Submitted name/email/phone/message on job-1's application form; toast notification "Application submitted! Your application for Senior Frontend Developer at TechCorp Solutions has been sent." appeared.

issue: No edit functionality for published jobs
actual: Employer dashboard job cards only expose an applications-toggle button and a delete button; there is no edit icon/link, clicking the job title does not navigate anywhere, and no edit route/form exists anywhere in the app.

evidence: Submitting empty required application form was blocked (focus moved to Full Name, checkValidity=false, required=true on name/email/message). Entering an invalid email "not-an-email" blocked submission with native validationMessage "Please include an '@' in the email address." identifying the invalid field.

issue: Salary min>max not validated; job published with invalid salary range
actual: Posted a job with Minimum Salary=150000 and Maximum Salary=90000 (min greater than max); the form submitted without any error, showed "Job posted successfully!", and the job appeared live everywhere displaying salary "$150k - $90k", a nonsensical range that should have been rejected with clear feedback.

issue: Duplicate application with same email for same job not blocked
actual: Submitted a second application to job-1 using the same email (test.user@example.com) already used for that job; the app showed the same "Application submitted!" success toast and created a second, separate application record (app-1787677926229) alongside the first (app-1787677919429), confirmed in the employer dashboard's application list for that job.

evidence: Submitting a valid application produced a visible toast "Application submitted!"; the application then appeared exactly once under job-1 in the employer dashboard with matching name (Test User), email, phone, and message.

Changing industry/location/type filters immediately updated both the "Showing N jobs" count and the visible list at each step, including a "No jobs found" / "Showing 0 jobs" no-results state; Clear filters immediately restored the full 9-job list.

issue: No persistence of state across page reload
actual: After a full page reload, the deleted "Product Designer" job reappeared in both the job-seeker listing and employer dashboard, the newly-posted "QA Automation Engineer" job disappeared, and the 2 newly-submitted applications for job-1 were gone (Applications count for job-1 reverted from 4 to 2, dashboard total from 5 to 3). All changes exist only in-memory and are lost on reload.

evidence: Each job card (e.g. job-1) displayed industry (Technology), employment type (Full-time), title (Senior Frontend Developer), company (TechCorp Solutions), location (San Francisco, CA), salary ($140k - $180k), posted date (Jan 15), and skill tags (React, TypeScript, CSS, Node.js).

job-1 detail page displayed Technology, Full-time, "Senior Frontend Developer", "TechCorp Solutions", "San Francisco, CA", "$140k - $180k", "Posted Jan 15", full multi-paragraph description with Responsibilities/Requirements, and 4 required skills — all matching the selected listing.

Expanded application list for job-1 showed each applicant as a distinct record with name (e.g. "Alex Johnson"), email (alex.j@email.com), phone (555-0101) when provided, message text, and a submission date ("Jan 20"); an application without phone omitted that field, applications with phone showed it.

issue: Newly created records show an inaccurate relative date ("Yesterday" instead of "Today")
actual: Browser clock read 2026-08-25T17:12 UTC (matching current date). Immediately after submitting an application, its date was displayed as "Yesterday" rather than "Today". Immediately after posting a new job, its posted date was displayed as "Posted Yesterday" instead of "Posted Today". This is an off-by-one relative-date calculation bug.
